## How to choose the right lawyer

Before engaging anyone, I'd recommend speaking with two or three firms and asking\:

- **Who will handle my case?** Ask to meet the lawyer who will actually do the work, not just the person conducting the initial consultation.
- **Are they an accredited family law specialist?** Verify this using the [Queensland Law Society's specialist directory](https://www.qls.com.au/)\.
- **What will it cost?** Request hourly rates, an initial cost estimate, likely disbursements and an explanation of what could make costs rise.
- **How would they approach my case?** Ask whether negotiation, mediation or court proceedings are likely to be appropriate.
- **What is their experience with my specific issue?** For example, business valuations, family trusts, relocation disputes, family violence or urgent parenting orders.

The Queensland Law Society recognises family law as a specialist accreditation area and provides a register to help people find accredited practitioners. [www.qls.com.au](https://www.qls.com.au/professional-development/specialist-accreditation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

*Note\:* This is general information to help you shortlist firms, not legal advice. The right choice depends on the facts, urgency and complexity of your matter.

## Let me narrow this down for you

What is the main issue you need a family lawyer for? That will help me recommend the most relevant two or three firms rather than simply the most highly ranked ones.

## How to choose the right lawyer

Before engaging anyone, I'd recommend speaking with two or three firms and asking\:

- **Who will handle my case?** Ask to meet the lawyer who will actually do the work, not just the person conducting the initial consultation.
- **Are they an accredited family law specialist?** Verify this using the [Queensland Law Society's specialist directory](https://www.qls.com.au/)\.
- **What will it cost?** Request hourly rates, an initial cost estimate, likely disbursements and an explanation of what could make costs rise.
- **How would they approach my case?** Ask whether negotiation, mediation or court proceedings are likely to be appropriate.
- **What is their experience with my specific issue?** For example, business valuations, family trusts, relocation disputes, family violence or urgent parenting orders.

The Queensland Law Society recognises family law as a specialist accreditation area and provides a register to help people find accredited practitioners. [www.qls.com.au](https://www.qls.com.au/professional-development/specialist-accreditation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

*Note\:* This is general information to help you shortlist firms, not legal advice. The right choice depends on the facts, urgency and complexity of your matter.
